# to: any one country, once, when the game rule zin_rule_debug_checks is on; hist: 1 Thaw 1748, three hours after the start
country_event = {
	id = zin_lore.20
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_debug_checks option = ON }
	}
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = zin_eindil_awake
					has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king
					has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead
					has_global_flag = zin_aurevan_crowned
					has_global_flag = zin_eindil_named
					has_global_flag = zin_horos_dead
					has_global_flag = zin_glo_with_eindil
					has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed
					has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
					has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing
					has_global_flag = zin_leren_withdrawal
					has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
					has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising
					has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east
					has_global_flag = zin_eindil_returned
					has_global_flag = zin_varner_dead
					has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed
					has_global_flag = zin_zol_manifested
					has_global_flag = zin_zol_withdrawn
					has_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead
					has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
					has_global_flag = zin_golbran_dead
					has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned
					has_global_flag = zin_ending_lost_cause
					has_global_flag = zin_ending_children_of_volgan
					has_global_flag = zin_ending_ashen_throne
					any_country = { has_war = yes }
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_start_check_failed
			log = "ZIN start: a story flag is set or a war exists on the first day"
		}
		else = {
			log = "ZIN start: no story flag is set and no country is at war"
		}
	}
}

# Pilgrims at Zilin
# hist: first 365 days, up to six times
country_event = {
	id = zin_lore.112
	title = zin_lore.112.t
	desc = zin_lore.112.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_hermitage
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	trigger = {
		original_tag = Y8G
	}
	immediate = {
		add_to_variable = { zin_lore_pilgrims = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_lore_pilgrims < 5.999 }
			}
			country_event = {
				id = zin_lore.112
				days = 40
				random_days = 40
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lore.112.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = zin_lore.112.a_tip
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
				check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0.999 }
				NOT = { original_tag = ROOT }
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_opinion_lore_goodwill }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_lore.112.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
		}
		add_political_power = 15
	}
}
